channel.title: Crypto Front Page
channel.description: Crypto Front Page reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto industry.

item.title: Ripple’s trust bank gets final OCC approval for RLUSD role
item.description: Ripple’s national trust bank won final OCC approval, placing RLUSD reserve management and custody under federal supervision while its issuer stays in New York.

item.title: Ripple gets final OCC approval for national trust bank
item.description: Ripple won final OCC approval for a trust bank that can manage RLUSD reserves and provide digital asset custody, while the stablecoin remains issued in New York.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin reward deals open to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC's GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying yield to holders but leaves platform reward arrangements to case-specific review, shaping how crypto firms can share reserve earnings.

item.title: OCC rules leave stablecoin exchange rewards open to review
item.description: The OCC finalized GENIUS Act rules that bar issuers from paying stablecoin yield but leave exchange rewards to case-by-case review, keeping a contested payout route open.

item.title: Set Slippage for Recurring Crypto Payouts
item.description: A recurring payout needs a fresh quote and a slippage cap on every run, sized to the route’s liquidity and the cost of a failed payment.

item.title: CoinDCX absorbs 15.99 million USDT loss after wallet sweep failed
item.description: CoinDCX says a failed transfer service left deposits in compromised retired wallets, costing it 15.99 million USDT; customer balances and trading were unaffected.

item.title: Aviva puts £50m tokenized share class on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors and Ripple have put a tokenized share class of a £22 billion sterling liquidity fund on the XRP Ledger, with Aviva committing £50 million to the on-chain offering.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin rewards open for crypto platforms
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying interest but leaves exchange rewards to case-by-case review, with the rule taking effect in January.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin for PayMe payments in Hong Kong
item.description: HSBC launched HKD stablecoin RedCoin through PayMe on Oct 23, with wallet access rolling out to users and payments to friends and merchants.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC finalized its GENIUS Act stablecoin rule, barring issuer-paid yield while leaving third-party rewards subject to case-by-case review from January.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin on PayMe for 3.3 million users
item.description: HSBC launched its HKD-denominated RedCoin through PayMe, where more than 3.3 million users can activate wallets for friend and merchant payments.

item.title: How to Receive Tokens Across Networks With Different Decimals
item.description: To receive tokens across networks with different decimals, verify the destination token and network, then let the wallet or bridge convert units for the amount sent.

item.title: How zerofi routes move a trade from quote to sale
item.description: zerofi routes separate cross-exchange transfers from three-trade loops, showing when each path fits and where fees, liquidity and transfer time change the result.

item.title: How a large crypto swap moves through a shallow pool
item.description: A large swap can move a shallow pool’s price against the trader. Learn how routing, split trades and execution limits affect the amount received.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards open to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars issuers from paying stablecoin interest directly, while leaving some third-party rewards open to case-by-case review.

item.title: Solana’s Alpenglow consensus upgrade is live on mainnet
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT voting with direct validator votes and certificates that target finality in about 150 milliseconds.

item.title: Three Bridge Cost Checks Before You Move Crypto
item.description: Before moving crypto, compare the source-chain transaction, the bridge route’s fee and exchange rate, and the gas or liquidity needed after arrival.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin rewards open to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying yield directly but leaves exchange rewards for case-by-case review, keeping a disputed route open.

item.title: Why a Zero-Balance USDT Recipient Uses More Energy
item.description: A USDT transfer uses more Energy when the recipient’s token balance is zero: the contract must create a balance record, and the sender pays for that extra work.

item.title: Portal Bridge in four questions before you transfer
item.description: Portal bridge transfers depend on the route and token you select: check what leaves your wallet, what arrives, how it is claimed and which fees apply.
